text:
Sam: Thinking aloud after the RFC: we should bake a "regional cutover dry-run" that enforces residency flags and simulates failover latency. who wants to prototype?
Lina: I can take the prototype. plan: simulate traffic, exercise soft-redirect, and validate no data leaves origin region.
Omar: Important to include KV ownership checks and a synthetic embed-heavy workload to show queue/backlog behavior.
Sam: Agreed. Dry-run phases I have in mind: 1) smoke probes, 2) dry soft-redirect (no real writes), 3) controlled drain with simulated writes routed to a shadow target, 4) final verification that residency rules were respected.
Lina: For smoke probes we'll use `curl -H "X-Region-Test: true" https://proxy/route?tenant=$T`. collect routing headers and `X-Target-Region`.
Omar: Add `kvctl owner --tenant $T` before and after each phase to assert lease ownership didn't change unexpectedly.
DevBot: :robot_face: I can orchestrate phases if you give me `cutover:dry-run` permissions. I will emit events to #architecture and attach artifacts.
Lina: We'll need a check that embeddings/long jobs are paused or farmed to background to avoid pressure spikes. recommend `jobctl pause --label cutover-dry-run` on the source cluster.
Omar: Also measure p50/p99 for the shadowed writes and compare against baseline. threshold: p99 increase <= 30% for PLG tenants, otherwise abort.
Sam: For residency verification, use `residency-audit export --tenant $T --since pre-dry-run` and verify no writes routed outside allowed regions. add an automated diff step.
Lina: LegalBot can we automatically tag tenants that require consent exports and include those in the dry-run artifacts?
LegalBot: :scales: Yes. We can provide a list via `legalbot tenants --consent-required` and a quick export hook. Ensure exports are encrypted at rest.
Omar: Failure modes: 1) unexpected write to non-resident region -> stop and notify legal+oncall, 2) KV lease hop -> snapshot + rollback, 3) queue buildup -> trigger `cutover-throttle`.
Sam: Good. Add abort conditions: dry-run duration > 10m, error rate > 1.5%, or unexpected residency diff > 0.
Lina: I'll draft a runnable script `scripts/region_dryrun.sh` that uses DevBot and produces an artifacts zip. will include `--simulate` and `--enforce` flags.
DevBot: :robot_face: When running with `--enforce` I will still mark actions as simulated unless `--commit` is provided. audit trail produced for both.
Omar: Tests: unit test for idempotency, integration job that runs on staging with 5 tenants (mix of regulated + PLG). record metrics in a dashboard.
Sam: Next steps: Lina to open PR with script and a README describing acceptance criteria. Omar to prepare metric dashboard. LegalBot to provide tenant list. We'll run the first dry-run on staging next Tues.
Lina: will do. tagging @Omar @LegalBot in the PR.
Omar: I'll prepare the dashboard and sample workload generator (embedding-heavy).
Sam: thanks. if dry-run goes well we can turn that into a pre-cutover gating job for production cutovers. :rocket:
thread_text_short: Discussion to build a regional cutover dry-run harness that enforces residency checks, simulates soft-redirects, and provides abort safeguards and audit artifacts.
